Name: PPJA Producer Converter
Author: Digus
Description:
[size=3][b]Objective:[/b][/size]
To let people convert their PPJA machines that were create with CFR, for the new ones that uses PFM.

[size=3][b]How does it work:[/b][/size]
Before loading the game, remove the old CFR pack and be sure you have the Json Asset pack for the machines.

When you first load the save game, this mod will look for all CFR machines and replace with the new Json Asset ones.

Places that this mod will look:
[list]
[*]Farmer's inventory
[*]All objects placed in the game locations.
[*]All chests placed in game locations.
[/list]This mod doesn't look for:
[list]
[*]Objects placed in other containers like freezer, mills,...
[/list]
This mod will also not take stack in consideration. So don't have your machines stacked up. Place then on the ground or put each one in a different inventory slot.

After loading a save with this mod installed, all machines should have been replaced. Play the day normally and save on sleep.
After that you can safely remove this mod. It will do no warm to keep it, but will check for the old machines everyday unnecessarily.
